claims.claim: The Promotion of Competition in the Food and Pharma Sector Law (חוק קידום התחרות בענפי המזון והפארם, 2014) requires chains with 3+ stores to publish machine-readable price XML; in force since 2015, pharma added in the 2024 rename

claims.claim: PromoFull RewardType controls discount application (1 = flat discounted price, 2 = fixed price for N units, 3 = Nth-item discount), with MinQty/MaxQty/MinPurchaseAmnt thresholds and a ClubId (non-zero = members only)
claims.raw_snippet: RewardType 1 flat discount, 2 fixed price for N units, 3 Nth-item discount; ClubId non-zero = club members only
